Topics: After filtering csvs with high semantic similarity to "unknown/to be researched", we developed a profile on what is considered important to research.
OSDR_Topics_Bar: Re-derives OSDR's topics (Embed_And_Project -> Topic_Model) and charts the largest ones by paper count. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge; matches the original ad-hoc run's parameters recovered from portal_taskrecord.
OSDR_Topics_Pie: Re-derives OSDR's topics and charts the largest ones' share. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
OSDR_Distance_Map: Re-derives OSDR's topics and positions one bubble per topic at its mean 2-D coordinate, labelled by its top keywords. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
Decadal_Topics_Bar: Re-derives Decadal_Survey's topics (Embed_And_Project -> Topic_Model) and charts the largest ones by paper count. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge; matches the original ad-hoc run's parameters recovered from portal_taskrecord.
Decadal_Topics_Pie: Re-derives Decadal_Survey's topics and charts the largest ones' share. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
Decadal_Distance_Map: Re-derives Decadal_Survey's topics and positions one bubble per topic at its mean 2-D coordinate, labelled by its top keywords. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
SB_Topics_Bar: Re-derives Space_Biology's topics (Embed_And_Project -> Topic_Model) and charts the largest ones by paper count. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge; matches the original ad-hoc run's parameters recovered from portal_taskrecord.
SB_Topics_Pie: Re-derives Space_Biology's topics and charts the largest ones' share. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
OSDR_Top_Terms: Counts word frequency across OSDR's raw text and charts the most frequent terms. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
Coverage_Grouped_Bar: The same Four_Corpora -> Theme_Emphasis -> Coverage_Share backbone as Fig12_TB_Coverage_4way, read as a grouped bar instead. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
Coverage_Heatmap: The same Four_Corpora -> Theme_Emphasis -> Coverage_Share backbone as Fig12_TB_Coverage_4way, read as a heatmap instead. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge.
SB_Papers_Per_Year: Reads the already-derived SB_Year_Counts (one row per year) and charts it as a line. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge; the year/count aggregation itself predates this template (see portal_taskrecord).
SB_Papers_Per_Year_Recent: Reads the already-derived SB_Year_Recent (one row per year) and charts it as a line. Reconstructed for the template+visualization merge; the year/count aggregation itself predates this template (see portal_taskrecord).
SB_SuperTheme_Year_Heatmap: Approximate reconstruction (no exact matching portal_taskrecord run): re-derives topics, coarsens them into ~9 super-themes the way Fig11_SB_SuperTheme_Sizes does, and reads year x super-theme as a density heatmap. The original run instead built a wide year x super-theme cross-tab and melted it off-platform; this version uses heatmap's own count-density mode instead so it stays fully in-vocabulary.
